items.title: JPMorgan, Visa, and Mastercard disclose cyberattack on third-party vendors
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase, Visa, and Mastercard said on Thursday that some select customer data, including emails, was accessed by attackers after a cyberattack on a vendor.

items.title: Vendor attack exposes JPMorgan Reserve cardholder emails
items.summary: About 16,700 Reserve card member records, with emails and ZIP codes but no names, sit in the JPMorgan files. No company has named any vendor.

items.title: Jim Cramer’s Warning for Anyone Buying Anthropic Stock: Use a Limit Order
items.summary: Anthropic opened far above its IPO price, then gave back a chunk of that gain within hours. Cramer says one small choice at the buy button separates smart entries from costly ones, and most retail buyers never see it coming.

items.title: Can banks provide the added security AI assistants require?
items.summary: Banks are blocking external artificial intelligence agents for now, but some bankers believe that is only temporary, and there is an opportunity to play a more direct role in agentic commerce.

items.title: 3 Dow Dividend Passive Income Stocks for Retirement, Led by a 64-Year Streak
items.summary: One Dow giant keeps raising payouts while another carries a rare asterisk from the financial crisis. Before you build a retirement paycheck, see which dividend is best covered, which stock looks stretched, and what risks hide beneath each yield.

items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway, JPMorgan and Procter & Gamble benefit from strong business fundamentals, but rising costs and growth challenges create risks.

items.title: Hackers Leak Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Customer Data
items.summary: A ransomware group breached third-party vendors, not the companies’ own systems. Visa said no card data was affected while Mastercard cited a limited cardholder subset.
